author: Forbes
description:
From television host to global entrepreneur, La La Anthony has mastered the art of multi-hyphenate hustle. In this episode of Forbes Talks Shop, Kim Peiffer sits down with the actor, mogul and fashion icon to discuss turning her real-life group chat with Kim Kardashian into a scripted series, the gritty reality of prison reform at Rikers Island and the secret to juggling ten jobs while barely sleeping.

La La opens up about her record-breaking 48-hour TikTok Shop live, why hosting the Met Gala is the ultimate "controlled fun chaos" and the "no gatekeeping" skincare tool that transformed her nighttime routine. Whether you’re an aspiring entrepreneur looking for business strategy or a sneakerhead seeking the ultimate collection inspo, this interview is packed with gems.

author: Forbes
description:
Years ago, @Lala Anthony dreamed of being interviewed on the iconic steps of the Met Gala. Now, she's back for her fifth year as a host of fashion's biggest night.

“It’s such an honor,” Anthony tells host Kim Peiffer on this week’s episode of #ForbesTalksShop, sharing how she feels like she's come full circle from her MTV days. “When Anna Wintour and Vogue ask you to host, then you're going to host!”

Balancing multiple projects across entertainment and her nonprofit @ThreeSixty, Anthony shares the routines and tools she relies on to keep it all moving. Watch the full episode at the link in bio.
